title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary 1969 Ark run, featuring monster Dark Star, soaring St. Stephen and a killer Alligator/Eleven/Caution sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine SBD with a clean patched splice between St. Stephen and It’s A Sin, delivering crystal‑clear fidelity that lets the band’s improvisational fire shine through. Reviewers rave about the hot first set and the inventive second‑set sandwiches – especially He Was A Friend Of Mine, Dark Star, Alligator into The Eleven > Caution, Hard To Handle and the tender It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue. Overall the show is hailed as one of the most consistent and exciting from the spring ’69 Ark run.

ai_rating.rationale: All 19 reviews give 5‑star ratings, uniformly praising both performance and sound quality; the show is described as exceptional with standout jams, while the SBD source is noted for excellent fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean SBD with a patched splice between St. Stephen and It’s A Sin; no noticeable hiss, drop‑outs or distortion – reviewers call the fidelity wonderful.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: Inventive setlists with seamless jam sandwiches – the first set burns hot while the second weaves It’s A Sin into St. Stephen and delivers a thunderous Caution after The Eleven, plus memorable transitions like Alligator into The Eleven.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for flawless guitar tone, soaring leads and standout slide work on Hard To Handle; his playing is described as perfect throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for stellar rhythm guitar alongside Jerry, especially in the He Was A Friend Of Mine intro.
